desc.zh: 从尺子覆盖的小例子，推导锚点与精确方向计数。
desc.en: Derive exact direction counts from a tiny ruler-and-pins example.

complexity: O(n² log C) time; O(n) auxiliary space, C = max(2, coordinate span)

concepts.name: Exact undirected direction
concepts.description: Reduce integer displacement by gcd and normalize its sign.

concepts.name: Anchor direction counting
concepts.description: Count peers sharing one line through a fixed point.

concepts.name: Earliest-anchor completeness
concepts.description: Prove a suffix scan still visits every member of an optimal line.
